# Redundancy and Coverage

Coordinate uniqueness, Full-F40 local similarity and lineage dependence are separate. Smaller F40 NN distance is only a structural-concentration proxy; it does not prove gradient redundancy. Near-duplicate threshold is the frozen candidate-pool NN P1 per replicate.
